why: Machine values for e096-secrets-box. The plugin reads this file; nothing here is hardcoded in src/ (project rule). SECRETS_BOX_NEEDS overrides the path (used by tests).
notes: vault_backend auto = age if installed, else the openssl fallback (see vault/RFC.md).
vault_file is created by the vault on first use, mode 0600, encrypted at rest.
The passphrase is never a config value: it is typed in the panel and travels to the vault on a pipe (fd 3).
